value.rationale: The exact third additive energy of the same signed geometric frequency sets singled out by current restriction theory is a natural combinatorial invariant. A new quadratic excess at ratio three, compared with linear corrections at four/five and no correction at >=6, quantifies the qualitative transition underlying the difficult boundary case. It is a complete all-n statement, not an arbitrarily chosen isolated numerical slice; its potential use is as a benchmark for more difficult weighted estimates, without claiming a downstream theorem.
